verdicts.reason: A has a clean left-to-right banner: can, then a left-aligned headline/body column with a shared edge, then the CTA. Its flaws are that the 'WEEKEND ONLY' eyebrow has dropped below the body copy, which breaks the reading order, and the legal line is microscopic. B's headline and body sit on different centres, 'WEEKEND ONLY' is orphaned under the can, and the tiny legal line floats loose in the middle bottom, so it reads as scattered fragments with no grid.
